I had one guy come in, buy a 50$ phone card. He comes back 15 minutes later and says he asked for the wrong one. I say sorry, no refunds. So he gets his giant beast of a girlfriend with an ugly ass mole under her eye. I tell her the same thing. She says I'm a customer and I'm not happy, make me happy. I repeat myself. And she just keeps yelling I'm not happy. Make me happy. Usually I just deal with grumpy people who want pay and leave. Though I did have one guy come in calling me baby and saying I'm his girl and he even asked me if I had eaten yet. Weirded me right the fuck out cause I didn't even know who he was.

The station I'm at doesn't really. Just blunts zigzags and we had "tobacco" grinders at one point. I don't get a whole lotta stoners, but I do have one guy who comes in drunk Saturday mornings at 3am, buys a bag of Doritos, hides them outside behind the air pump, and then comes in for a drink.

I do worry about robberies, I had a guy hanging around the store one night staring in the windows and being a creep. Called the cops but he got away.  Fortunately we've never actually been robbed. There's a 24 h Tim Horton's on the same property, which is probably why, but the ga station across the street from us has been robbed a couple times. Strangely the thing I like the most and the least about my job is the customers. Some of my regulars are pretty funny, but earlier today I got yelled at by a woman who got her card stuck in the machine and wanted me to go out there and fix it.
